name: Scott Clarkson
headline: Elevate ERP Consulting Ltd | ACMA | CGMA | Certified NetSuite ERP Consultant
about:
Bringing expertise and efficiency to NetSuite implementations and optimisations.

As a Qualified Accountant and seasoned NetSuite expert, I specialise in providing tailored solutions to businesses seeking to leverage the full potential of ERP. With a proven track record of successful projects across various industries including e-Commerce, Fintech, Arts & Entertainment and Wholesale Distribution, I offer comprehensive services including implementation, customisation, integration, and ongoing support.

My approach is client-centric, focusing on understanding unique business needs and delivering solutions that drive growth and streamline operations. Whether it's optimising existing setups, migrating to the cloud, or building custom workflows, I ensure that each project is executed with precision and attention to detail.

Experience & Key Knowledge Areas:
• Record-to-Report, Procure-to-Pay, Quote-to-Cash, Billing.
• Advanced Revenue Management.
• Multi-Book Accounting.
• Advanced Intercompany Management.
• Data Migration.
• Fixed Asset Management.
• Electronic Bank Payments.
• Integration Design, Mapping & Testing - Salesforce, WebExpenses, Expensify.
• Reporting, Saved Searches, SuiteAnalytics, SuiteFlow, Advanced PDF/HTML Templates.

Key Skills/Attributes:
• Implementation – Strong understanding of business and systems and a project lifecycle. Able to plan a practical, workable strategy and carry it out effectively.
• Co-ordination – Able to prioritise and focus on objectives, draw out team members skills and delegate work effectively.
• Communication – Excellent written and verbal communication skills, key to the consulting role. Confident in communicating with a range of stakeholders of various seniority, from a variety of countries and cultures.
• Problem Solver – Natural problem solver, work to understand the root of the problem and analyse potential solutions in detail before presenting a recommended approach to proceed.
• Integrity – Professional in approach, honest and with strong moral principles both at home and work.
